title: pm: eval-run records are exempt from the first-touch sweep and H13/H74; scenario-eval SKILL.md joins the line ratchet
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi98eF7dmau7ewzzV1EuovZQd)_

Fixes #34012

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:评测记录标签 `eval-run` 与 `qa-run` 一样被首触扫描和 H13/H74 巡查豁免;内部技能 scenario-eval 的 SKILL.md 纳入行数棘轮。
- 为什么改:评测记录按技能规定终身不挂优先级/车道/状态标签,但扫描只认 `qa-run`,开着的记录会被要求首触;scenario-eval 落地时没进棘轮名单,门禁看不到它增长。
- 风险与回滚:只动 PM 工具脚本与两份内部技能文本,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`(两个豁免常量与自测行)、`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`(新增两行)、`.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`(纯空白折行 + 一句改写)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 应见 scenario-eval 两行 ✓(156 行/上限 156,表行 237/pin 237)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S)。

## What changes

**S1 — `eval-run` joins `qa-run` wherever a record label is exempt.** The `scenario-eval` skill forbids priority, `domain:*` and `pm:*` labels on an `eval-run` record for its whole life, as `checklist-test` does for `qa-run`; only `qa-run` was exempt in code.

- `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`: `EXCLUDED_LABELS` gains `eval-run`; its mirrored rule phrase and header line follow; the exclusions self-test row covers it.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: `H13_EXEMPT_LABELS` and `H74_EXEMPT_LABELS` gain `eval-run`, with one new H13 pin (`H13: eval-run exemption`), the H74 per-label loop and exact-list pin extended, and the H74 row prose naming it. Nothing outside the two constants and their rows moves (PR #34054's record-reader region untouched).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`: the one rule line naming `qa-run` now names `eval-run` too (one line edited, line count unchanged).

**R1 — `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` joins the skill line ratchet.**

- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: `CEILINGS` row at 156 and `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row at 237, both the landed measurement (headroom 0); the header's "four other" playbook SKILL.md files becomes five; the self-test row naming the covered skills lists `scenario-eval` (row label renamed in the battery roster and the table together).
- `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`, per the seat's claim amendment (comment 6899758395 on #34012): (1) the sentence saying the triage sweeps do not know `eval-run` yet, so a record must close in its filing round, was false once S1 lands; reworded to the post-S1 rule (2 lines → 1); (2) its 26 lines over the 120-byte budget re-wrapped whitespace-only to the ratchet's own `wrapLine` canonical form (130 → 156 lines, 0 offenders, bytes identical once whitespace is removed). Without (2), seeding the row reds 26 lines at once: `MAX_LINE_BYTES` is a global rule and the script's header forbids a per-file exemption, so the card's "width pin seeds at the measurement" can only mean the table-row pin.

Line counts (whole file, before → after): `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` 131 → 156; `triage-duties.md` unchanged; pm-dispatch family unchanged (`check:pm-skill-ratchet` green). No forced test edits: every self-test change is an added pin or an extended expected list.

## Tests

Each edited script's own self-test, on head `6c876af8`:

- `node scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `45 cases pass across 5 batteries`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `5280 cases pass` (H74 battery 61/46).
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `164 cases pass`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` before the re-wrap: red, `scenario-eval/SKILL.md has 26 line(s) over the 120-byte budget`; after: exit 0, `156 lines (ceiling 156; headroom 0)`, `widest table row is 237 bytes (pin 237; headroom 0)`.

## Acceptance notes

- None beyond the scope above.
